name: Library Statistics
description: Scans selected Jellyfin libraries, charts formats and growth, shows latest and largest titles, and compares merged versions with exact paths and MediaInfo.
overview: Library statistics, trends, media insights and merged-version analysis.

versions.changelog: Expands duplicate detection beyond merged versions using provider IDs and conservative title/year or episode-coordinate matching, while still requiring distinct media paths.
Reuses Jellyfin Helper's fixed donut-chart layout and arc renderer, restores scrolling throughout the dashboard, and adds a growth timeline plus latest/largest movie and series views.

Fixes repeated merged-movie groups, adds Jellyfin Helper-style donut charts, corrects unreadable select menus, clarifies library/type badges, and aligns the icon and page with Jellyfin's active theme.
First public release. Includes a Jellyfin Helper-style dashboard, selectable library exclusions, media statistics, and a merged-version duplicate finder with exact paths and per-version MediaInfo.
